_about: n-Hexane (1) + o-Xylene (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of n-hexane, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of n-hexane, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Gupta, B. S., Lee, M. J.[Ming-Jer], Isobaric Vapor Liquid Equilibrium of Binary Systems of Hexane or Octane with 1,2-Dimethylbenzene or 1,3-Dimethylbenzene at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 57 (2012) 1237-1243
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 9, 10. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0097. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.32 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
